first.rationale: Run a tightly targeted promotional-pricing experiment for demonstrably price-sensitive SMB prospects, because the competitor threat is immediate and prior evidence indicates this segment can yield acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the pricing record for qualification, revenue durability, and discount effects; verify onboarding evidence because declining completion may constrain conversion and make onboarding the stronger alternative if its effect is materially larger or more durable. Guard against low-quality, discount-dependent acquisition and assess qualified revenue rather than top-of-funnel signups alone.
